result.title: Seeing Is Not Reaching: Instruction Shortcuts Override Visual Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models
result.comment: 31 pages, including supplementary material. Code: https://github.com/QZhang2111/psg
result.summary: Vision-language-action models (VLAs) are expected to inherit visual grounding from vision-language models, yet often reach for an object's training location after it has been moved. Across six VLAs, we identify two shortcuts: a scene shortcut, where the arm follows the scene's original task despite a new instruction, and an instruction shortcut, where the instruction retrieves the requested object's training location. In $π_{0.5}$, the instruction shortcut persists even though object-name attention follows the moved target. We call this Seeing Is Not Reaching. To determine whether this grounding is unused or overridden, we separately mask an image-mediated grounding pathway and a direct instruction-to-action pathway. Masking the grounding pathway eliminates reaches to moved targets, whereas masking the direct pathway increases them. Thus, grounding already guides action but is often overridden by the instruction shortcut, which acts through the direct pathway. We introduce Pathway-Separated Guidance (PSG), which amplifies grounding and suppresses the shortcut without training or external target locations. On LIBERO-PRO Object under Position perturbations, PSG raises the target-reaching rate from 22.0% to 52.6% and task success from 16.6% to 40.8%, while largely preserving performance on the original tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 在六个 VLA 模型中发现物体移走后机械臂仍伸向训练位置的「看到却未触及」现象，归因于场景捷径与指令捷径；作者分别掩码图像中介的接地通路与指令直达动作通路，确认接地已影响动作但常被捷径压制，并提出免训练的 Pathway-Separated Guidance 放大接地、抑制捷径。
AI.relevance_reason: 与「视觉内容是否真正被使用」「视觉旁路与捷径覆盖」直接相关，其通路分离与掩码干预可供核查 LVR 中视觉证据筛选与贡献分配；但研究对象是机器人动作输出而非 latent 推理状态，需进一步确认可迁移程度。
